races.paceDynamic: Rosie Frith is the sole confirmed pace-setter and will dictate terms from the front without pressure in the early stages. The prominent runners Tornado Kiss, Joyful Tidings, Allsortz, Treasured Royal and Bay Of Supremacy will track her in a loose line, while the hold-up horses Amiata, Bad Boy Rizz, Fox In Flight and Soulful Diva will be held up in rear. With only one leader and a moderate pace likely, this race strongly favours the prominent runners who can position close enough to strike but avoid the front-running burden that may catch up with Rosie Frith.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and Rosie Frith weakens in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The trackers get first run on the tiring leader with enough left to hold off the closers. Bay Of Supremacy and Allsortz are perfectly positioned to capitalize on their recent good form.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely slow and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of the hold-up horses pay dividends as they find clear runs through tiring horses. Amiata's class and Bad Boy Rizz's finishing kick become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Rosie Frith gets very soft fractions and the prominent horses fail to organize
scenarios.body: The leader's tactical advantage proves insurmountable despite her big weight burden. Her stamina reserves from longer trips help her resist the late challengers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If several prominent runners go too early and stop quickly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair where positioning trumps class ratings. The fresher horses with the clearest runs benefit from the tactical chaos.

watchPoints.text: Rosie Frith dictating uncontested fractions could make her very hard to peg back despite the 141lb burden
Bay Of Supremacy and Allsortz both racing prominently could clash for the same tactical position behind the leader
Bad Boy Rizz needs luck in running from his hold-up style in a small field where gaps may be limited
Amiata dropping back to 5f after 6f success requires sharp early pace to utilize his finishing kick
Fox In Flight returning after 158-day break makes his fitness level the key unknown factor

races.paceDynamic: Jordan Breeze is the primary pace-setter with prominent runners Kilmood Susan, An Laochmor, Steel Magnolia, and Snowballs likely to sit close. With multiple prominent horses but only one confirmed leader, the pace should be honest but not destructive. The large field of 17 runners over the minimum trip creates tactical complications, with hold-up horses needing luck in running on the tight Cork circuit. This race shape favours prominent racers who can track the pace and kick, as pure front-runners may get pressured while hold-up horses face traffic problems in a big field sprint.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Jordan Breeze sets sustainable fractions without excessive pressure
scenarios.body: The pace-tracking horses get first run on the field while hold-up horses struggle for room in the cavalry charge. An Laochmor or Steel Magnolia can utilise their tactical speed to strike from ideal positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Jordan Breeze breaks cleanly and the prominent horses don't press early
scenarios.body: The leader gets an easy time in front and kicks clear in the final furlong before the field can organise. Jordan Breeze maintains her recent good form to hold off late challenges.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Traffic Luck
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses or a hold-up horse finds a clean passage
scenarios.body: The early speed fizzles out creating a tactical affair where the patient riders benefit. Art Of Unity or Hero Of The Hour get the splits they need to unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Jordan Breeze goes too slow and multiple horses converge simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint where any horse with tactical speed can win from any position. The form book goes out the window in a blanket finish where positioning matters more than ability.

watchPoints.text: Jordan Breeze breaking slowly would create early scrambling and tactical chaos in this big field sprint
Rain arriving before the race significantly helps Art Of Unity and Steel Magnolia while hindering Hero Of The Hour
An Laochmor and Colin Keane combination tracking Jordan Breeze closely through the early stages
First-time headgear changes on Snowballs (blinkers retained) and Jazzit (first-time cheekpieces) for immediate impact
The 3yo handicappers Spirit Above, Windsor Lily and Mini Cotai all stepping down significantly in trip for first time

races.paceDynamic: Dragon Of Malta is the standout pace-setter with L L Koulsty and Send Harry likely to race prominently, but this looks a moderate pace scenario given the field composition. With five hold-up horses (Gleneagle Bay, Usuario Amigo, Mallavelly, Goal Exceeded, Brewing) and only three genuine early types, the tempo will be controlled rather than demanding. Dragon Of Malta can dictate terms without serious pressure through the early stages, setting up a tactical finish. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and front-runners who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will affect the large hold-up contingent in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Dragon Of Malta gets an easy lead with L L Koulsty and Send Harry tracking.
scenarios.body: The pace will be steady but not slow, allowing the leaders to kick clear when the hold-up horses are stillorganising. Front-runners and prominent racers avoid the scramble and have first run on the field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If L L Koulsty and Send Harry press Dragon Of Malta early creating genuine tempo.
scenarios.body: The increased pace will suit the proven hold-up performers who can produce their best finishing kicks. Mallavelly and Goal Exceeded have the class to capitalise on a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Jam Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and all nine runners hit the straight in a bunch.
scenarios.body: The prominent racers get first run while the hold-up horses struggle for racing room in a blanket finish. L L Koulsty's 3yo profile and Send Harry's consistency give them the edge in a messy conclusion.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Closer Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If Dragon Of Malta sets fractions too slow and the field compacts approaching the final furlong.
scenarios.body: Usuario Amigo or Brewing could emerge from the pack if they get the perfect trip through. However, this requires everything to fall right for horses drawn in the pack.

watchPoints.text: Dragon Of Malta may need the run badly after 192 days off, despite being the logical pace-setter
Watch for traffic problems in straight affecting Mallavelly, Goal Exceeded and other hold-up horses in small field
L L Koulsty could be overpriced given 3yo allowance and forward style that suits this race shape
Brewing's AW-only winning record makes him vulnerable on turf return in testing conditions
Send Harry's consistency and prominent style could be undervalued in what looks a tactical contest

races.paceDynamic: Camelot Queen is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the gate, likely setting a sustainable gallop without pressure through the early stages at this 1m4f trip. With most of the field showing hold-up tendencies (Gaoth Chuil, De Vega Queen, Mare Crisium, Carmel's Phoenix, I Hope You Dance, Cosmetic) and only Sangreal showing prominent tendencies, there's minimal early pace pressure. The lack of pace competition creates a tactical race where Camelot Queen can control fractions, while the hold-up brigade will need the leader to come back to them in the final furlongs. This race shape strongly favours the front-runner and any horse that can track closely, as the soft early pace may not provide enough tempo for the back-markers to make up significant ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Camelot Queen Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Camelot Queen gets her own way in front through moderate fractions
scenarios.body: She can dictate ideal fractions and prove hard to peg back, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from too far back. The lack of pace pressure allows her to save energy for a sustained finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes very slow and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup with a sprint finish from the back, allowing superior class to show. Carmel's Phoenix's Listed form and recent improvement become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Sangreal tracks Camelot Queen closely and the fractions remain honest
scenarios.body: The O'Brien filly can use her prominent style to stay in touch before out-battling the leader, while avoiding the traffic issues that may affect those held up. Her superior breeding and 270,000gns price tag suggest untapped ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the Harrington newcomers shows significant improvement on debut form
scenarios.body: The Frankel breeding of Invincible Destiny or War Of Will bloodlines of Werifesteria could produce a performance well above their inexperienced profiles. Fresh legs and unexposed ability upset more exposed rivals.

watchPoints.text: Camelot Queen breaking slowly or being hustled early would completely alter the pace scenario and favour hold-up horses
Watch for any newcomer showing early pace alongside Camelot Queen as this would create the tempo the hold-up horses need
Shane Foley's tactics on Werifesteria will reveal whether Harrington expects immediate impact or is giving her experience
Colin Keane's positioning on Gaoth Chuil in the early stages will show if she's expected to overcome her long absence

races.paceDynamic: Magna Gee Gee is the only confirmed front-runner in this large field and should get an uncontested lead at a sustainable gallop. With She's Ideal, Not Simple and Barretstown sitting prominent behind the leader, the pace will be steady rather than frantic through the early stages. The real race begins when the large pack of hold-up horses including Starting Monday, Khormor Syd and Hosanna Power mount their challenges from the 3f pole. This tactical setup strongly favours horses with a finishing kick who can stay the extended 1m2½f trip.

scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays moderate and the field remains bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: Starting Monday and Khormor Syd will have ideal conditions to unleash their proven finishing kicks in the final 2f. Both have strong recent form and the tactical setup plays directly into their hands.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runners capitalize
scenarios.trigger: If Magna Gee Gee sets genuine fractions and the hold-up brigade fails to quicken
scenarios.body: She's Ideal can use her recent good form to stay on strongly, while Not Simple might recapture his Cork winning form from this position. The pace scenario would suit their racing styles perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runner gets away
scenarios.trigger: If Magna Gee Gee builds an unassailable lead while the field hesitates behind
scenarios.body: The leader could steal a march turning for home and prove hard to peg back despite moderate recent form. Her all-weather winning ability suggests she has untapped potential on turf.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete outsider strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses into a sprint finish and the fancied horses disappoint
scenarios.body: Barretstown defends his course and distance victory from 2024, or long-absent Highway Sixty One capitalizes on his low weight. Chaos in large handicaps can produce shock results.

watchPoints.text: Starting Monday and Khormor Syd both represent the same yard which has strong recent form - expect one to be the chosen runner
Magna Gee Gee could steal this if the field allows her too much rope in front given the lack of early pace pressure
Several horses including Seti and Highway Sixty One are returning from long layoffs which makes their fitness questionable
Multiple horses including Not Simple, Lauderdale King and Believeth have patterns of fading in the finish
The large field size increases the chance of traffic problems for hold-up horses who need clear runs
